{{Top|leg}}
'''Coral pikes''' were ceremonial weapons that were used by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Each pike was unique, though all were made of a [[Unidentified coral|particularly dense coral]] found only on Dac.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
